jobs.title: O9 Product Planning Consultant(m/w/d) - Germany
jobs.description:
Role
: Principal Consultant/o9 Product Planning Consultant

Technology
: o9 Product Planning

Location
: Germany

Job Description

Today, the corporate landscape is dynamic and the world ahead is full of possibilities! None of the amazing things we do at Infosys would be possible without an equally amazing culture, the environment where ideas can flourish and where you are empowered to move forward as far as your ideas will take you.

At Infosys, we assure you that your career will never stand still, we will inspire you to build what’s next and we will navigate further together. Our journey of learnability, values and trusted relationships with our clients continues to be the cornerstones of our organization and these values are upheld only because of our people.

Your Role

In the role of Principal Consultant, you will anchor the engagement effort for assignments, all the way from business process consulting and problem definition to solution design, development and deployment. You will be pivotal to problem definition and discovery of the overall solution and guide teams on project processes, deliverables. As a thought leader in your domain, you will be the key advisor to architecture and design reviews. You will anchor business pursuit initiatives, client training, in-house capability building. You will have the opportunity to shape value-adding consulting solutions that enable our clients to meet the changing needs of the global landscape.

We are seeking an experienced o9 Product Planning Consultant to design, build, and deploy end to end Product Planning and Integrated Business Planning (IBP) solutions using the o9 Solutions platform.

The role involves close collaboration with business stakeholders to translate planning requirements into scalable technical solutions using IBPL, o9 Reference Models, PL/SQL based data integrations, and Python plugins.

Key Responsibilities

Product Planning & Functional Ownership

Experience in Implementing Product Planning processes including:
Demand–Supply netting
Inventory & safety stock planning
Capacity constrained supply planning
Scenario simulation & what if analysis
Support S&OP / IBP cycles with actionable planning outputs
Translate business requirements into o9 planning models and measures

Required Skills & Qualifications

Mandatory Skills

Strong hands on experience with:
o9 IBPL (Integrated Business Planning Language)
o9 Product Planning & Supply Planning modules
Excellent knowledge of:
Product Planning & Supply Chain concepts
SQL / PL SQL (Oracle preferred)
Experience with:
Time series planning data
Multi dimensional models

Good To Have Skills

Python development experience (Pandas, NumPy preferred)
Experience working with:
o9 S&OP / IBP
Demand Planning & Forecasting
Exposure to:
Cloud data pipelines
Advanced analytics or ML use cases

Personal

Besides the professional qualifications of the candidates, we place great importance in addition to various forms personality profile. These include:

High analytical skills
A high degree of initiative and flexibility
High customer orientation
High quality awareness
Excellent verbal and written communication skills

About Infosys

Infosys is a global leader in next-generation digital services and consulting. We enable clients in 56 countries to navigate their digital transformation. With over three decades of experience in managing the systems and workings of global enterprises, we expertly steer our clients through the many next of their digital journey. We do it by enabling the enterprise with an AI-powered core that helps prioritize the execution of change. We also empower the business with agile digital at scale to deliver unprecedented levels of performance and customer delight. Our always-on learning agenda drives their continuous improvement through building and transferring digital skills, expertise and ideas from our innovation ecosystem.

Visit www.infosys.com to see how Infosys can help your enterprise navigate your next.

All aspects of the hiring process and employment at Infosys are based on merit, competence and performance. We are committed to embracing diversity and creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Infosys is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

jobs.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio und AI Solutions Consultant (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Als Microsoft Copilot Studio und AI Solutions Consultant (m/w/d)
entwickelst du intelligente und skalierbare KI Lösungen für unsere Kunden.

Du begleitest wertvolle Anwendungsfälle von der ersten Idee über Prototyp und Pilot bis in den sicheren produktiven Betrieb. Im Zentrum stehen Microsoft Copilot Studio, Microsoft Foundry, Azure AI Services
sowie die Integration von Unternehmensdaten, Prozessen und bestehenden Plattformen.

Was du bei uns machst

Konzeption, Entwicklung und Betrieb intelligenter Agenten und Multi Agent Lösungen mit Microsoft Copilot Studio.
Design und Implementierung generativer KI Lösungen mit Microsoft Foundry, Azure OpenAI und weiteren Azure AI Services.
Entwicklung passender Lösungsarchitekturen einschließlich Orchestrierung, Retrieval Augmented Generation und Anbindung von Unternehmensdaten.
Integration von Connectors, APIs, Microsoft 365, Power Platform und weiteren Unternehmenssystemen.
Durchführung technischer Discovery Workshops sowie Umsetzung von Prototypen, Proof of Value, Pilotprojekten und produktionsreifen Lösungen.
Mitgestaltung unseres Agent as a Service Angebots sowie Beratung zu Sicherheit, Governance, Responsible AI, Betrieb und Skalierung.

Wann du zu uns passt

Praktische Erfahrung in der Entwicklung von Agenten mit Microsoft Copilot Studio und idealerweise in der Umsetzung von Multi Agent Szenarien.
Fundierte Kenntnisse in Microsoft Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Services oder vergleichbaren Plattformen für generative KI.
Technisches Verständnis für Large Language Models, Prompt Engineering, Orchestrierung, Retrieval Augmented Generation und Datenintegration.
Erfahrung mit Power Platform, Connectors, REST APIs, Automatisierung und Enterprise Architekturen.
Kenntnisse zu Sicherheit, Governance, Datenschutz, Compliance und verantwortungsvoller KI im Unternehmenskontext.
Teamfähigkeit, Freude an Innovation und sichere Kommunikation auf Deutsch und Englisch.
Eine oder mehrere passende Microsoft Zertifizierungen, zum Beispiel AI-900, AI-102, AB-100, AB-620 oder AB-730, oder die Bereitschaft, diese zeitnah zu erwerben.

Hey, wir sind Skaylink.

Begleite uns auf unserer Cloud Journey!

Als Part of Vodafone bringen wir unsere Cloud-DNA und Innovationskraft ein. Gemeinsam treiben wir zentrale Cloud- und Transformationsprojekte voran. Von Cloud-Migrationen über Security-Lösungen bis hin zu Modern-Work-Projekten schaffen wir spürbaren Mehrwert für unsere Kund*innen. Dabei nutzen wir Synergien und bündeln unsere Stärken. So entstehen Lösungen mit nachhaltiger Wirkung und genau das macht uns zu einem der führenden Anbieter im Bereich Cloud-Technologien.

Unser Anspruch ist es, echte Ergebnisse zu schaffen, die messbar Wirkung zeigen und Projekte nachhaltig voranbringen. Wir beraten nicht nur, sondern setzen um. Denn Verantwortung zu übernehmen und Wirkung zu erzielen, gehört für uns zusammen.

Bei uns zählen deine Expertise, deine Leidenschaft und deine Motivation, etwas zu bewegen. Unterschiedliche Hintergründe, Perspektiven und Erfahrungen machen uns stark. Sie schaffen den Raum, in dem du dich einbringen und weiterentwickeln kannst.

Wenn du nicht nur mitlaufen, sondern wirklich etwas bewegen willst, bist du bei uns richtig.

Was du von uns hast

🎯 Purpose
– Deine Expertise einsetzen (in Projekten bei re­nom­mierten Unternehmen wie BMW Group, Henkel oder KWS)

🌍 Flexibilität
– Deine Balance finden (u. a. Workation, Urlaubsflexibilisierung)

🧩 Miteinander

Du + Skaylink = Perfect Match?

jobs.title: Expansion Customer Success Manager (m/w/d)  Frankreich C2 FR/DE
jobs.description:
Pflegia ist eine digitale Plattform zur Vermittlung von Pflegekräften.

Unsere Mission: Pflegeeinrichtungen und qualifizierte Fachkräfte schnell, fair und passgenau zusammenzubringen – mit digitalen Lösungen, die wirklich funktionieren.

Wir sind ein wachsendes Unternehmen mit Hauptsitz in Berlin, das auf Eigenverantwortung, transparente Kommunikation und partnerschaftliches Arbeiten setzt. Für das nächste Kapitel unserer Erfolgsgeschichte schlagen wir eine Brücke nach Westeuropa: Von unserem Headquarter in Berlin aus starten wir die Expansion in den französischen Markt.
Dafür suchen wir empathische und umsetzungsstarke Talente im Customer Success, die den Beziehungsaufbau zu französischen Pflegekräften von Tag 1 an mitgestalten.

Aufgaben

Erstkontakt & Betreuung der ersten französischen Pflegehelden! – Du bist die zentrale Ansprechperson für französischsprachige Pflegekräfte, begleitest sie empathisch ab der ersten Kontaktaufnahme und führst sie erfolgreich durch den Vermittlungsprozess.
Prozessaufbau & Kandidaten-Betreuung im Zielmarkt! – Du nimmst die Wünsche der Pflegekräfte auf Französisch auf, gestaltest ihren Bewerbungsprozess unkompliziert und hilfst dabei, Candidate-Experience-Standards für den französischen Markt neu zu etablieren.
Passgenaue Stellenvermittlung für Frankreich! – Du bringst französische Talente und die ersten Partnerunternehmen zusammen, indem Du Qualifikationen und Wünsche präzise mit den Angeboten der Arbeitgeber matchst.
Feedbackschleifen für den Markteintritt nutzen! – Du sammelst aktiv Rückmeldungen von Kandidaten im neuen Markt, erkennst kulturelle oder prozessuale Besonderheiten und hilfst so, unser Angebot stetig an Frankreich anzupassen.
Enger Schulterschluss mit dem Berliner Sales-Team – Gemeinsam mit dem Key Account Management entwickelst Du maßgeschneiderte Lösungen, um die Erwartungen der ersten französischen Kandidaten und Partnerunternehmen zu übertreffen.
Präzise Dokumentation & Datenpflege – Du pflegst alle Kandidatendaten auf Französisch in unseren Systemen ein und stellst sicher, dass die Kennzahlen für unsere Expansion jederzeit verlässlich sind.
Pionierarbeit im Candidate Success – Du schaffst von Berlin aus echte Win-Win-Situationen im neuen Zielmarkt und gestaltest die internationale Ausrichtung von Pflegia aktiv mit.

Qualifikation

C2-Sprachniveau in Französisch und Deutsch: Nachgewiesen durch Deinen Lebenslauf oder Zertifikate. Du betreust Kandidaten und Ansprechpartner auf Französisch und arbeitest eng mit dem Berliner Team auf Deutsch zusammen – absolute Sprach- und Verhandlungssicherheit auf beiden Sprachen ist zwingend.
Pioniergeist & Aufbaumentalität: Du hast Freude daran, Abläufe im Kundenservice für einen neuen Markt mitzugestalten und flexibel auf die Dynamik einer frühen Expansionsphase zu reagieren.
Kommunikationsstärke und Empathie – Du kannst komplexe Themen im Pflegebereich auf Französisch und Deutsch verständlich erklären und gehst stets wertschätzend auf Menschen zu.
Organisationsgeschick – Du behältst auch bei vielen parallelen Anfragen aus dem neuen Markt den Überblick und arbeitest hochstrukturiert.
Eigeninitiative und Lösungsorientierung – Du packst Hürden im Markteintritt proaktiv an und entwickelst pragmatische Lösungen für kandidatenseitige Herausforderungen.
Digitale Affinität – Du fühlst Dich im Umgang mit CRM-Systemen, Slack und Zoom wohl und arbeitest gerne datenbasiert.

Benefits

Top ausgestattetes Office in Berlin – Ein modernes Büro mit zentraler Lage, erstklassiger Anbindung und inspirierender Arbeitsumgebung.
Attraktive Vergütung – Ein faires Grundgehalt plus ungedeckelte Provision, die Deinen Erfolg direkt belohnt.
Einfluss & Wachstum – Du bist maßgeblich an unserem Eintritt in den französischen Markt beteiligt und gestaltest diesen Meilenstein aktiv mit.
Unbegrenzte Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten – Zeig, was in Dir steckt! Bei uns gibt es keine Limitationen – ob Du Dich fachlich weiterentwickeln, mehr Verantwortung übernehmen oder eine Führungsposition anstreben möchtest: Deine Karriere ist das, was Du daraus machst! Wir wachsen schnell und bieten Dir die Möglichkeit, gemeinsam mit uns zu wachsen.
Moderne Arbeitsausstattung – Laptop, Bildschirm und Headset stehen Dir für ein produktives Arbeiten zur Verfügung.
Effiziente Tools und Systeme – Nutze Slack, Zoom und unser maßgeschneidertes CRM-System, um Deinen Arbeitsalltag effizient zu gestalten.
Regelmäßige Team- und Networking-Events – Von After-Work-Sessions über Fußball oder Volleyball bis zu Teambuilding-Aktivitäten und Firmenläufen.
Kostenlose Verpflegung – Frischer Kaffee, kühle Getränke, Snacks und Obst stehen Dir jederzeit zur Verfügung.
Personalisierte Snack-Bestellungen – Über unsere wöchentliche REWE-Bestellung kannst Du Deine Lieblingssnacks direkt ins Büro liefern lassen.
Friyay-Feeling – Jeden Freitag lassen wir die Woche gemeinsam mit Pizza und Bier im Büro ausklingen.
Haustierfreundliches Büro – Dein Hund ist bei uns herzlich willkommen.
27 Urlaubstage pro Jahr – Für ausreichend Erholung und eine ausgewogene Work-Life-Balance.

Werde Wegbereiter unseres nächsten großen Kapitels!

Bring Deinen Drive ein, baue echten Social Impact auf und gestalte unseren Markteintritt in Frankreich von Berlin aus aktiv mit.

jobs.title: Workforce Planning Analyst
jobs.description:
Boyd Gaming Corporation has been successful in gaming jurisdiction in which we operate in the United States and is one of the premier casino entertainment companies in the United States. Never content to rest upon our successes, we will continue to evolve and retain a position of leadership in our industry. Our past success, our current business philosophies and our sound business planning, combine to position Boyd Gaming Corporation to maximize value for our shareholders, our team members and our communities.

Job Description

The Workforce Planning Analyst is responsible for the preparation of departmental work schedules, which include but are not limited to Gaming, Food & Beverage and Hotel. The Workforce Planning Analyst is responsible for ensuring staffing levels are both adequate and economical while providing excellent guest service.

Team Player: Demonstrated by a willingness to work with the team to achieve common goals.
Achieves Results: Proactive self-starter who get things done, usually without being told or reminded.
Innovative: Ability to utilize logic, imagination and context to create intelligent solutions.
Intellectual Curiosity: Passionately engaged in learning by asking questions and actively seeking out answers.
Commitment to Excellence: Demonstrates ongoing effort to improve products, services, or processes over time or all at once.
Ethics: Demonstrates integrity and exercises discretion in handling confidential information.
Customer Service: Demonstrates excellent guest service by building cooperative, helpful relationships with other teams in order to work most effectively
Analyze business needs to determine proper staffing levels and create the most efficient schedule; prepare and post all departmental schedules on a weekly basis.
Recommend staffing policies and procedures to ensure consistency and overall standardized practices.
Prepare forecasts and work schedules for various departments ensuring adequate staffing for excellent customer service.
Assist all departments with staffing schedules that provide optimum labor levels for the business.
Maintain accurate and timely records of staffing levels in order to schedule per business needs and increase overall productivity.
Provide input to staffing planning goals based on knowledge of departmental capacity and potential.
Approval or rejection of ongoing requests for shift changes, change in days off and requested time off in comparison to staffing needs.
Communicate effectively with employees and all levels of management.
Work closely with Human Resources and Payroll to ensure all scheduling practices comply with labor laws and company policies.
Perform all functions with the highest level of integrity.
All duties are to be performed in accordance with departmental and company policies, practices, and procedures.
Perform all other job-related duties as requested

Qualifications

One to two (1-2) years or more of related scheduling experience.
Knowledge of overall principles of operations and staffing requirements.
Strong problem solving, analytical skills.
Use computer systems and projection technology to create, communicate and present information as well as review data, research alternatives, document information, prepare action and implement results.
Must have intermediate level skills with Microsoft Excel/Word/Outlook and basic office equipment.
Ability to understand change management.
Working knowledge of state specific laws and requirements.
Good written and verbal communication skills and demonstrate ability to resolve all situations in a professional manner.
Excellent customer service skills. Have interpersonal skills to deal effectively with all business contacts.
Have initiative, strive for continuous improvement.
Strong team player that has a direct approach and is solution oriented.
Professional appearance and demeanor.
Work varied shifts if needed, including weekends and holidays.
Able to effectively communicate and present in English, in both written and oral forms.
Able to obtain/maintain any necessary certifications and/or licenses.
Ability to work independently, prioritize based on urgency and work through high volume and stressful time periods.

Preferred

Previous knowledge and experience with Virtual Roster or any scheduling software system.
Experience with Workday and/or any related payroll timekeeping systems
Experience working with any collective bargaining agreements (Union).
Previous experience working in a casino resort with understanding and knowledge of operational standards

jobs.title: Manager, Customer Success - Commercial Markets
jobs.description:
Welcome to Planet. We believe in using space to help life on Earth.

Planet designs, builds, and operates the largest constellation of imaging satellites in history. This constellation delivers an unprecedented dataset of empirical information via a revolutionary cloud-based platform to authoritative figures in commercial, environmental, and humanitarian sectors. We are both a space company and data company all rolled into one.

Customers and users across the globe use Planet's data to develop new technologies, drive revenue, power research, and solve our world’s toughest obstacles.

As we control every component of hardware design, manufacturing, data processing, and software engineering, our office is a truly inspiring mix of experts from a variety of domains.

We have a people-centric approach toward culture and community and we strive to iterate in a way that puts our team members first and prepares our company for growth. Join Planet and be a part of our mission to change the way people see the world.

Planet is a global company with employees working remotely world wide and joining us from offices in San Francisco, Washington DC, Germany, Austria, Slovenia, and The Netherlands.

About The Role

The Manager for Customer Success - Commercial Markets
leads a global team of high-touch Customer Success Managers (CSMs) dedicated to accelerating adoption, retention, and expansion across Planet’s key commercial accounts (including agriculture, energy, insurance, finance and enterprise technologies). Reporting to the Global Director of Customer Success, this position oversees daily operations for the commercial portfolio and ensures the team has the strategy and resources needed to deliver measurable business value and ROI.

This role serves as a leader and advocate for strategic enterprise customers, acting as a key escalation point for critical account health and commercial growth. You will work in lockstep with Regional Sales Directors, Account Executives, Pre-Sales, and Product leadership to execute a unified commercial strategy. By empowering global commercial enterprises to seamlessly integrate satellite imagery and geospatial analytics into their core business workflows, this role directly drives Planet’s commercial growth and mission.

This is a full-time, hybrid role which will require you to work from our San Francisco or Washington D.C. office 3 days per week.

Impact You'll Own

Commercial Accountability: You are responsible for regional/segment performance metrics, including Gross Retention, Net Retention (NRR), Net Promoter Score (NPS), account expansion, and team hiring/retention targets.
Team Leadership & Coaching: Recruit, mentor, and lead a high-performing team of CSMs (US and Europe based), establishing best practices for high-touch customer engagement and value delivery.
Executive Escalation & Account Health: Serve as the senior escalation point for key commercial accounts, navigating complex stakeholder dynamics and turning around at-risk enterprise relationships.
Sales Co-Pilot & Growth Partner: Partner closely with Sales Leadership and Account Executives to align account growth strategies, ensuring a unified front during renewals and expansion opportunities.
Value Realization & QBRs: Co-lead executive business reviews (EBRs) and establishes clear ROI frameworks to help enterprise clients measure and articulate the business impact of Planet solutions.
Data-Driven Success: Analyze customer usage data, product telemetry, and health scores to identify expansion opportunities, mitigate churn risk, and optimize account strategies.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Collaborate with Pre-Sales, Solutions Engineering, and Professional Services to ensure smooth transitions from post-sale implementation to long-term workflow integration.
Voice of the Customer: Partner with Product Management to align commercial requirements, feature requests, and industry use cases with Planet’s product roadmap.

What You Bring

4+ years of customer success, account management, or strategic customer-facing experience in enterprise B2B SaaS or technology, with 2+ years in a supervisory or team leadership role.
Deep understanding of commercial business models (how enterprise customers generate revenue, measure ROI, and evaluate technology trade-offs).
Track record of building and maintaining relationships with C-suite and VP-level stakeholders within complex enterprise organizations.
Ability to align internal teams (Sales, Product, Professional Services, Legal) around customer outcomes.
Proficiency in using Customer Relationship Management (CRM) and Customer Success (CS) tools (e.g., Salesforce, Gainsight, Zendesk) to manage workflows and report on team metrics.
Exceptional verbal and written communication skills in English, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear business value for executive audiences.

What Makes You Stand Out

Experience in a field related to Earth Observation, Geographic Information Systems (GIS), or public policy.
Familiarity with geospatial solutions, remote sensing, or GIS imagery and how commercial enterprise accounts integrate location intelligence into business processes.
Ability to translate customer data into actionable insights.
Experience leading organizational change management efforts within large, complex entities.
Experience leveraging AI technologies to increase team efficiencies and guide customers to derive automated insights from geospatial data.
Deep domain experience in key commercial verticals such as Agriculture, Energy, Insurance, Finance, or Supply Chain.

Application Deadline

October 27, 2026 by 11:59p / 23:59 CET (Central European Time)

Wellness Program and Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
Home Office Reimbursement
Monthly Phone and Internet Reimbursement
Tuition Reimbursement and access to LinkedIn Learning

Compensation

The US base salary range for this full-time position at the commencement of employment is listed below. Additionally, this role might be eligible for discretionary short-term and long-term incentives (bonus and equity). The final salary range is determined by job related experience, skills and location. The range displays our typical hiring range for new hire salaries in US locations only. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process.

This role is eligible for commission.

San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Why We Care So Much About Belonging.

We’re dedicated to helping the whole Planet, and to do that we must strive to represent all of it within each of our offices and on all of our teams. That’s why Planet is guided by an ultimate north star of Belonging—dreaming big as we approach our ongoing work. If this job intrigues you, but you’re thinking you might not have all the qualifications, please... do apply! At Planet, we are looking for well-rounded people from around the world who can contribute to more ways than just what is listed in this job description. We don’t just fill positions, we aspire to fulfill people’s careers, most excited about folks who are motivated by our underlying humanitarian efforts. We are a few orbits around the sun before we get to where we want to be, so we hope you’re excited to come along for the ride.
